exercises.why: **создавали** — создава́ть (imperfective): to create; to found, to originate; to set up, to establish. Wiktionary: созда́ть + -ва́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **создаёт** — создава́ть (imperfective): to create; to found, to originate; to set up, to establish. Wiktionary: созда́ть + -ва́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **выдавай** — выдава́ть (imperfective): to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; to produce; to deliver up, to give up, to extradite; to betray, to give away. Wiktionary: вы- + дава́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **выдавайте** — выдава́ть (imperfective): to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; to produce; to deliver up, to give up, to extradite; to betray, to give away. Wiktionary: вы- + дава́ть.

exercises.why: **издаёт** — издава́ть (imperfective): to publish, to print; to edit; to issue, to promulgate, to enact; to utter, to emit, to exhale. Wiktionary: изда́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give, to impart; to attach
to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прида́ть — to give, to impart; to attach; создава́ть — to create; выдава́ть — to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; издава́ть — to publish, to print.
**издаёт** — издава́ть (imperfective): to publish, to print; to edit; to issue, to promulgate, to enact; to utter, to emit, to exhale. Wiktionary: изда́ть + -ва́ть.
